channel.title: NBC Sports Fantasy Football News
channel.description: Latest player news and analysis for fantasy football from NBC Sports.

item.title: Rams ruled out Terrance Ferguson (ankle/hamstring) for Week 10 against the Cardinals.
item.description: Ferguson is expected to be out for a couple of weeks, though the Rams are fortuitously on bye in Week 11. The rest of the Rams’ tight ends are in varying states of health. Colby Parkinson (ribs) will likely play through his injury again. Tyler Higbee (illness) and Davis Allen (oblique) did not practice on Thursday. Their game status has not been revealed.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Trent McDuffie (back) is questionable for Week 10 against the Cardinals.
item.description: The Rams were optimistic about McDuffie practicing on Thursday and playing on Sunday. The former did not happen. It sounds like he has a chance to play this weekend, but his recovery appears to be going slightly slower than expected. Rams S Kam Curl (toe) is also questionable to play, though LG Steve Avila (hamstring) has been ruled out.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Myles Garrett (knee) is questionable for Week 10 against the Cardinals.
item.description: Rams coach Sean McVay told reporters that he expects Garrett to play. This is unfortunate news for the Cardinals, who will be led by rookie Carson Beck in his first NFL start. Garrett played very well last week against the Commanders, but his preseason knee issue is apparently still bothering him. Hopefully, he can get healthy before the season’s end.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Rams coach Sean McVay said Puka Nacua’s (knee/toe) return timeline has not changed.
item.description: A few days ago, McVay told reporters that Nacua would not be placed on injured reserve due to transaction limitations, so it was a bit surprising to see him land there yesterday. The move prompted some concern. He was initially expected to return in Week 14 or 15, and he will officially be eligible to return on the latter date against the Cowboys. As of today, he is on track to do so, just in time for the fantasy football playoffs. Nacua should not be dropped in any format. He will be a WR1 upon returning.-Nic Bodiford

item.title: Travis Etienne (hamstring) is questionable for New Orleans’ Week 10 game against the Panthers.
item.description: He did practice again today, finally hitting a full session, so he at least has cleared a full week of practices if nothing else. If Etienne does play he could be a reasonable FLEX option. There are reports that he could be on a snap count if he does play, and that mixes with the early-season usage to create a situation that isn’t necessarily guaranteed to smash. That said, the Panthers are an enticing matchup.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Chiefs coach Andy Reid said Kenneth Walker sat out Friday’s practice with a tight groin.
item.description: Reid added “we’ll see how he feels through this afternoon, with rehab, and through tomorrow.” Not exactly a glowing endorsement for Walker playing, though we expect the injury report later today to at least read questionable. If Walker were unable to go, Emmett Johnson would probably find himself with a low-end RB1 workload against the Falcons.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Tailese Fuaga (knee) won’t play in New Orleans’ Week 10 game against the Panthers.
item.description: Fuaga has a knee sprain, per Kellen Moore. It sounds like a short-term thing and Moore has said he won’t need to go on injured reserve. Asim Richards and Mason Murphy are the backup tackles and Richards played left tackle while Kelvin Banks was sidelined earlier this season.-Rivers McCown

item.title: CJ Donaldson (shoulder) won’t play in New Orleans’ Week 10 game against the Panthers.
item.description: The passing-down blocking back’s absence should create more opportunities for Alvin Kamara and, possibly, Travis Etienne in the passing game.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Harold Fannin (groin) is not on Cleveland’s final Week 10 injury report against the Texans.
item.description: He’ll start and be a useful TE1 against a Texans defense that has had it’s share of downs in 2026. Fannin practiced every day this week and never seemed to be in real danger of missing time with the groin injury — he picked it up in practice ahead of last week’s game against the Saints.-Rivers McCown

item.title: Denzel Boston (toe) is questionable for Cleveland’s Week 10 game against the Texans.
item.description: He made it back on to the practice field on Friday, so he’s probably on the optimistic side of questionable at this point. Todd Monken did say at his Friday presser that Boston is “trending in the right direction.” Boston did miss the first two sessions of the week but has been no stranger to the injury report this year and has tended to gut it out. Boston was seen wearing a walking boot as he left the locker room. He still has a chance to play, but his status is worth monitoring closely.-Rivers McCown
